title: Gartner Peer Insights Scraper — Input
description: Scrape public Gartner Peer Insights product profiles, ratings, market listings, and review samples. Provide product URLs/slugs and/or market URLs. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

productUrls.title: Product / reviews URLs
productUrls.description: Gartner Peer Insights product page URLs. Accepts short form https://www.gartner.com/reviews/product/{slug} or long market/vendor/product/reviews URLs. Use this when you already know the product page. NOT a free-text search — use searchTerms or productSlugs for that.

marketUrls.title: Market category URLs
marketUrls.description: Gartner market/category listing URLs such as https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/meeting-solutions. Returns product cards (name, rating, review count, SEO slug). NOT individual product review pages — use productUrls for those.

productSlugs.title: Product SEO slugs
productSlugs.description: Product SEO names without a full URL (e.g. zoom-meetings, salesforce-sales-cloud). Converted to /reviews/product/{slug}. Prefer productUrls when you have the canonical link.

searchTerms.title: Product name hints
searchTerms.description: Free-text product names slugified into /reviews/product/{slug} lookups (e.g. Zoom Meetings → zoom-meetings). Best-effort public slug resolution; prefer exact productUrls when known. NOT a full Gartner site search API.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (legacy)
startUrls.description: Optional requestListSources-style URL list. Same classification as productUrls/marketUrls. Prefer productUrls or marketUrls for clarity.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Hard cap on review/highlight rows saved per product. Default 5 for quality tests. Range 1-500. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

maxProducts.title: Max products per market
maxProducts.description: Hard cap on product cards saved from each market URL. Default 20. Range 1-200.

includeProductSummary.title: Include product summary row
includeProductSummary.description: If true (default), saves one product profile row (ratings, vendor, description) per product URL in addition to review rows.

includeReviewHighlights.title: Include likes/dislikes highlights
includeReviewHighlights.description: If true (default), also saves public likes/dislikes highlight snippets as review-highlight rows when present on the product page.

sort.title: Review sort (authenticated mode)
sort.description: Ignored for public page samples. Default most helpful. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

sessionCookie.title: Restricted access control
sessionCookie.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
